about: At the Draynor Village Rooftop Course's rough wall with Agility 66, so every course and shortcut built so far is open: Draynor (1), the Gnome Stronghold (1, ::tele 2474 3438), Al Kharid (20), Varrock (30) and the eight Misthalin shortcuts (13 to 66, with Lumbridge Swamp's raft and desert stone). Run on and full; the bank holds a graceful set to try the run energy bonus.
notes: For the Agility runner scripts (test-runner/examples/agility-*.json) and looking at the courses by hand. Hitpoints are a new account's 10, so a fall's damage shows.
